parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.ticket_ai_predictions (
    ticket_id,
    status,
    category,
    priority,
    summary,
    provider,
    model,
    prompt_version,
    schema_version,
    error_code
)
VALUES ($1, 'pending', NULL, NULL, NULL, 'openai', $2, $3, $4, NULL)
RETURNING
    id AS prediction_id,
    ticket_id,
    status AS prediction_status,
    category,
    priority,
    summary,
    provider,
    model,
    prompt_version,
    schema_version,
    error_code,
    created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    updated_at AS prediction_updated_at;

WITH inserted_ticket AS (
    INSERT INTO public.tickets (
        requester_email,
        requester_area,
        title,
        description
    )
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
    RETURNING id, status, created_at, updated_at
),
inserted_prediction AS (
    INSERT INTO public.ticket_ai_predictions (
        ticket_id,
        status,
        category,
        priority,
        summary,
        provider,
        model,
        prompt_version,
        schema_version,
        error_code
    )
    SELECT
        id,
        'pending',
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8,
        NULL
    FROM inserted_ticket
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, category, priority, summary, provider, model, prompt_version, schema_version, error_code, created_at, updated_at
)
SELECT
    t.id AS ticket_id,
    t.status AS ticket_status,
    t.created_at AS ticket_created_at,
    t.updated_at AS ticket_updated_at,
    p.id AS prediction_id,
    p.status AS prediction_status,
    p.category,
    p.priority,
    p.summary,
    p.provider,
    p.model,
    p.prompt_version,
    p.schema_version,
    p.error_code,
    p.created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    p.updated_at AS prediction_updated_at,
    $9::text AS test_mode
FROM inserted_ticket t
CROSS JOIN inserted_prediction p;

SELECT
    p.id AS prediction_id,
    p.ticket_id,
    p.status AS prediction_status,
    p.category,
    p.priority,
    p.summary,
    p.provider,
    p.model,
    p.prompt_version,
    p.schema_version,
    p.error_code,
    p.created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    p.updated_at AS prediction_updated_at,
    t.status AS ticket_status,
    $3::text AS test_mode
FROM public.ticket_ai_predictions p
JOIN public.tickets t ON t.id = p.ticket_id
WHERE p.id = $1
  AND p.ticket_id = $2;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE public.ticket_ai_predictions
    SET
        status = 'succeeded',
        category = $1,
        priority = $2,
        summary = $3,
        error_code = NULL,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = $4
      AND ticket_id = $5
      AND status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, category, priority, summary, provider, model, prompt_version, schema_version, error_code, created_at, updated_at
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows,
    (SELECT id FROM updated) AS prediction_id,
    (SELECT ticket_id FROM updated) AS ticket_id,
    (SELECT status FROM updated) AS prediction_status,
    (SELECT category FROM updated) AS category,
    (SELECT priority FROM updated) AS priority,
    (SELECT summary FROM updated) AS summary,
    (SELECT provider FROM updated) AS provider,
    (SELECT model FROM updated) AS model,
    (SELECT prompt_version FROM updated) AS prompt_version,
    (SELECT schema_version FROM updated) AS schema_version,
    (SELECT error_code FROM updated) AS error_code,
    (SELECT created_at FROM updated) AS prediction_created_at,
    (SELECT updated_at FROM updated) AS prediction_updated_at,
    (SELECT status FROM public.tickets WHERE id = $5) AS ticket_status;

    UPDATE public.ticket_ai_predictions
    SET status = 'succeeded', category = $1, priority = $2, summary = $3,
        confidence = $4, review_required = $5, review_reason = $6,
        attempt_count = $7, last_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        error_code = NULL, failure_kind = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

)

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.ticket_ai_predictions
  SET status = 'failed', category = NULL, priority = NULL, summary = NULL,
      confidence = NULL, review_required = NULL, review_reason = NULL,
      error_code = $1, failure_kind = $2, attempt_count = $3,
      last_attempt_at = CASE WHEN $3::integer > 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = $4 AND ticket_id = $5 AND status = 'pending'
  RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, error_code, failure_kind, attempt_count
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows,
       (SELECT id FROM updated) AS prediction_id, (SELECT ticket_id FROM updated) AS ticket_id,
       (SELECT status FROM updated) AS prediction_status, (SELECT error_code FROM updated) AS error_code,
       (SELECT failure_kind FROM updated) AS failure_kind, (SELECT attempt_count FROM updated) AS attempt_count;
